4 random bio recs:

1. Roberts' Napoleon bio - required reading for any young philosopher-king with dreams of marching a 600,000-man Grande Armée across the Niemen River

2. River of Doubt - Morris' "Rise of Roosevelt" is required bio reading, but River of Doubt is an easy read - sort of a semi-bio, just an absolutely insane story, well-written. TR is prob #1 pick for American role model

3. Stephen King - On Writing. Never read any of his books - not required. Great writer, great book, half memoir, half writing masterclass. 

4. Prideaux - Nietzsche bio. Is this a GOAT bio, no, but its a grade-A bio on a lunatic of a human. Read this before u read anything he wrote - adds valuable context
